Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. For example, it's my duty to lock up at night.

Grace usually spends the weekend reading at the zoo. The experience taught Grace more than any book could. On Monday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. For example, my grandfather walks in the park every day.

Grace thanked Max for the honest advice. Little by little, things began to change. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, she is easily the school's sharpest debater.

Grace has practiced badminton for three years and won a prize last term. The office has become an important part of daily life. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The history class discussed the rise of fascism in Europe.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Max advised Grace to try singing as a new hobby. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
